brand.name: Solaride
brand.description: SOLARIDE provides customized rooftop solar panel installations for residential, commercial, and agricultural sectors across North India, including Punjab, Haryana, Chandigarh, and Rajasthan.
brand.target_audience: Homeowners, businesses, and agricultural landowners in North India (Punjab, Haryana, Chandigarh, Rajasthan) looking to reduce electricity bills and adopt clean energy.
usps: Backed by qualified engineering graduates from IIT Bombay and PEC Chandigarh
Founder's 4,000 KM solo cycling journey for clean energy awareness
Local solar teams in Mohali and Hisar
Assistance with PM Surya Ghar subsidy and net metering
Potential to cut electricity bills by up to 98%
offers: Diwali offer: 10% off rooftop solar installation

goal: Ad for factory owners: from 31 Dec, non-DCR solar panels are banned and the cost goes up by more than 10,000 rupees per kW. Install before the deadline.

nonAnswer.question: What offer should the ad highlight for factory owners?

rejectedUnderV2.note: interview-v2 replies the old claim check rejected for ₹10,000 although the goal says 10,000 rupees
